title: Latest record is current; a renewal drives at once and keeps history
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. An asset (e.g. unit 402 · 2019 Freightliner Cascadia of "Aacrest Works") enrolled on a schedule that has a compliance service "CVIP" (Term 12 months), seeded with the standard steps.
  3. Open the asset page; the asset card is on the left and its Compliance section sits below Contact.
  4. A current CVIP record: Term 12 months, End date 14 Oct 2026, Certificate number AB-4471902 (+ Add record, Save).
  5. A second schedule "Yard PM" with a compliance service also named "CVIP" exists.
  6. A second asset whose CVIP row reads "Overdue" (its record's End date is in the past).
custom_steps:
1. Click + Add record beside the current record: Term 12 months, Start date 14 Oct 2026, Certificate number AB-5500001; Save. Read the Compliance section and the CVIP row's due date.
  2. Open the earlier record (AB-4471902) and look for Edit; then Edit the current record and change its number to AB-5500002.
  3. Remove the asset from its schedule, then enrol it on "Yard PM"; read the CVIP row.
  4. Look on the asset page for a Certificates tab.
  5. On the second asset click + Add record on CVIP with a new Term 12 months starting today; read the row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The new record is current at once (even though it starts on 14 Oct 2026) and the row's due date moves to its End date, 14 Oct 2027; the earlier record stays beneath it, read-only.
  • The earlier record cannot be edited; Edit changes only the current record (now AB-5500002).
  • On "Yard PM" the CVIP row uses the same record: it carries over to the same-named service.
  • There is no Certificates tab; records are reached from the asset card and from the service row.
  • Adding the record moves the overdue service's due date at once (it no longer reads "Overdue").

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10565 (S8, Compliance inspection records on the asset), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S8 (What a record belongs to; S8-R8, S8-R12, S8-N1, S8-N3, S8-E4); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R12: “A renewal drives the service as soon as it is entered, even when its Start date is still ahead”
  • S8-R12: “Renewing adds a new record; earlier ones stay read-only beneath the current one. Edit corrects the current record only”
  • S8-R12: “When the asset is enrolled on another schedule, a record added for a service of the same name carries over”
  • S8-N3: “There is no Certificates tab in v1. Records are reached from the asset card, per S8-R13, and from the service row that uses them”
  • S8-E4: “Adding a record for a service that is overdue moves its due date immediately”
  • S8-R8: “A record belongs to the asset and survives the removal of any schedule”
